## 中文原文
晚上你打算给宝宝煮辅食。你洗好了西兰花，切成小块放进蒸锅。等时间到打开盖子的时候，扑面而来的热气烫到了你的手背。你赶紧关上蒸锅，拿了冰袋敷在手背上。

## My translation
I planned to cook assistant food for my baby this evening.
I washed the broccoli up, chopped them into small pieces and put them onto the steam pot.
When it was the time to open the lid, the coming viper burned the back of my hand.
I immediately turned off the steam pot, and put ice bag on my hand.

## Revised version
I was going to make complementary food for my baby this evening.
I washed the broccoli, chopped it into tiny pieces and put it in the steamer.
When I went to lift the lid, the rising steam scalded the back of my hand.
I turned off the steamer right away and put an ice pack on my hand.

## Key phrases
- was going to，打算
- complementary food，辅食
- steamer，蒸锅
- when I went to lift the lid
- rising steam，扑面而来的热气
- right away = immediately
- ice pack，冰袋
